The closest match is LLM unbranding, which defines the task of neutralizing brand-related language, slogans, and stylistic markers in LLM outputs while preserving the model’s general capabilities and utility [1]. It proposes an inference-time method, MUTE, that aims to eliminate brand leakage without fragile parameter updates [1].

For broader text sanitization, another paper introduces domain-agnostic redaction from natural-language rules, with transparent justifications for each redaction and high reconstruction error / high redaction precision [2]. A related benchmark, RedacBench, evaluates policy-conditioned redaction across domains and measures both security and utility preservation [8].
